newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes little changed in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes little changed in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed little changed in lower trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 579.95 from 580.05 on Friday.
Trade volume was 4.29 million dinars against 7.36 million dinars. Turnover on the bond market was 1.56 million dinars.
Most of the trade on the primary market was in STB Bank with 50,000 shares changing hands at an unchanged price of 22.03 dinars.
Banque du Sud was up 1.46 dinar to 25.42 dinars. Leasing firm Tunisie Leasing eased 0.2 dinar to 31 dinars, and BTEI bank down 0.2 dinar to 21.8 dinars.
Chemical firm AL KIMIA was down 1.06 dinar to 40 dinars.
